product_family: Google Scholar is a free, web-based academic search engine that indexes and indexes full text or metadata of scholarly literature across journals, conference papers, theses, dissertations, preprints, and other academic publications. Core products: Scholar search, Scholar profiles, Scholar citations tracking.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type I or II)
certifications.proof_quote: Google Scholar is NOT explicitly listed among SecOps services in scope for SOC 2 compliance. Only Google Cloud Platform, Google Workspace, and specific SecOps services (Mandiant) are covered. Scholar is a free consumer service not included in enterprise compliance scope.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Google Scholar is NOT listed in Google's ISO 27001 scope. Certification covers 'systems, applications, people, technology, processes, and data centers serving Google Cloud Platform, Google Workspace and Google Ads' but does not explicitly include Scholar as a covered service.

certifications.name: ISO 27017
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of Google Scholar-specific ISO 27017 certification. This standard applies to Google Cloud services, not Scholar.

certifications.name: ISO 27018
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of Google Scholar-specific ISO 27018 certification. This standard applies to Google Cloud services, not Scholar.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: If European Union or United Kingdom data protection law applies to the processing of your information, you can review the European requirements section below to learn more about your rights and Google's compliance with these laws.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Google Scholar is NOT HIPAA compliant. HIPAA coverage is limited to Google Workspace and Google Cloud services configured with BAA (Business Associate Agreement). The free Scholar service does not offer HIPAA compliance and should not be used for Protected Health Information (PHI).

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of Google Scholar having PCI DSS certification. This compliance standard is not mentioned in Scholar documentation or Google's Scholar-specific terms.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of Google Scholar holding ISO/IEC 42001 AI governance certification. Google has published AI governance frameworks (Secure AI Framework / SAIF) but does not claim this certification specifically for Scholar.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of Google Scholar holding CSA STAR AI or cloud security certification.

privacy.ai_training_note: Google's privacy policy permits data collection from Scholar (search queries, articles viewed, user interactions) for service improvement and personalization. Specific opt-out mechanisms for Scholar data are not publicly documented. Enterprise tier users of Google Workspace/Cloud have contractual guarantees against training on customer data, but Scholar is a free consumer service with no such guarantees. Data may be used to train Google AI models (Gemini, Search improvements) but Scholar-specific training practices are not disclosed.
privacy.data_region: Multi-region (Google data centers worldwide); EU data may be transferred to US subject to Standard Contractual Clauses and GDPR adequacy determinations

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: HTTPS/TLS 1.2+ enforced; Google Scholar is served over HTTPS with modern TLS encryption

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: Data at rest encrypted using Google Cloud infrastructure encryption standards (AES-256 or stronger), inherited from Google's data center practices

security.name: Data Center Security
security.value: Physical security via layered model: custom electronic access cards, biometrics, 24/7 monitoring, laser beam intrusion detection, perimeter fencing; racks monitored for tampering

security.name: Infrastructure
security.value: Runs on Google Cloud Platform infrastructure shared with Google's consumer services; inherits Google's hardware hardening and security controls

security.name: Public Trust Center / Security Documentation
security.value: No Scholar-specific trust center. Google publishes compliance reports for Cloud/Workspace via Compliance Reports Manager, but Scholar is not listed.

products.name: Google Scholar Search
products.data_scope: Free, consumer-grade service. Indexes full text/metadata of scholarly publications. User search queries and viewing history collected.
products.notes: Primary product. Free to use without sign-in. Signing in with Google account unlocks saved library, citation exports, and email alerts. No institutional account required.

products.name: Google Scholar Citations
products.data_scope: Free citation tracking service. Requires user profile. Tracks articles, theses, books, and citations attributed to a scholar.
products.notes: Citation metrics and publication tracking tied to researcher profiles. Data publicly visible if profile is public.

products.name: Google Scholar Profiles
products.data_scope: Optional user-created profiles. Data includes name, affiliation, publications, citation metrics. Can be public or private.
products.notes: Users control visibility. Profile data subject to Google's privacy policy and standard data practices.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (free search, free citations tracking, free profiles; no paid tier offered by Google Scholar itself)
compare.data_residency: Multi-region Google data centers (US, Europe, Asia, etc.); specific Scholar instance location not configurable by users

flags: CERTIFICATION SCOPE AMBIGUITY: Google Scholar is NOT explicitly listed in Google Cloud's SOC 2, ISO 27001, or other enterprise compliance certifications. A procurement team reviewing Google's certifications may incorrectly assume Scholar is covered. This is a over-claim risk — Scholar is NOT in scope for these certifications.

HIPAA ALERT: Google Scholar is NOT HIPAA-compliant and must not be used to store, search, or index Protected Health Information (PHI). Only Google Cloud/Workspace with BAA are HIPAA-certified. Health researchers should NOT use Scholar for sensitive patient data.

DATA TRAINING UNCLEAR: Google's privacy policy permits data collection from Scholar for service improvement, but Scholar-specific opt-out mechanisms are not documented. Researchers may not realize their search queries and viewing history could contribute to AI model training.

NO SERVICE-SPECIFIC SECURITY DOCS: Scholar has only generic Terms of Service; no dedicated privacy notice, data processing agreement, or security white paper. Procurement teams accustomed to vendor trust centers will find none for Scholar.
IDENTITY CLARITY: Google Scholar is operated by Google LLC (Alphabet subsidiary), not a separate vendor. Compliance burden falls on Google as a whole, not a dedicated Scholar team.

FREE-TIER SERVICE: Scholar is a free, consumer-grade research tool, not an enterprise product. Compliance posture reflects consumer-service standards, not SLA/compliance guarantees typical of paid products.
